source_of_truth: Corporate service-size standards inferred from Riviera corporate built-in recipe yields and Kuschi-approved service-variant patterns. Base rules remain riviera_data/service_variants.json.

corporate_boxed.portion: 1 savoury croissant per guest or box
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Box by the dozen for corporate morning tea or individually only when requested. Fill split must be set on the event prep sheet.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or edible flowers as optional premium finish where packing allows.

platter.portion: count by ordered croissants, 12 piece minimum order
platter.service_rule: Serve fresh or warm only when delivery timing supports pastry quality. Do not seal hot croissants for long delivery.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or edible flowers as optional premium finish.

corporate_boxed.portion: 1 sweet croissant per guest or box
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Fill and finish close to delivery. Keep chilled if filling requires it.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Edible flowers, berry garnish or flavour-matched crumb as optional premium finish.

platter.portion: count by ordered croissants, 12 piece minimum order
platter.service_rule: Use platter only for same-day service. Do not stack filled croissants.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Edible flowers or berries as optional premium finish.

corporate_boxed.service_rule: Keep chilled below 5 C. Label nut-containing bowls clearly or keep nuts separate for mixed dietaries.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Berries, edible flowers or toasted coconut as optional premium finish.

corporate_boxed.service_rule: Keep cold. Dress no more than 20 minutes before send or pack dressing separately for longer delivery.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or extra shaved parmesan as optional premium finish.

corporate_boxed.service_rule: Keep pita chips separate or on top at handover so they stay crisp. Confirm GF change before using pita alternative.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or pomegranate as optional premium finish.

corporate_boxed.service_rule: Keep tzatziki in dip well or separate pot. Do not seal warm chicken directly against cold labneh.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, lemon zest or edible flowers as optional premium finish.

corporate_boxed.portion: 1 lasagne portion with side salad per guest
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Use two-compartment box for takeaway. Keep salad and dressing separate from hot lasagne.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or parmesan finish where packing allows.

corporate_boxed.service_rule: Toast seam down and wrap for delivery. Vent briefly before boxing so wraps do not steam soggy.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: No garnish needed for boxed wraps; offer premium sauce/relish instead.

corporate_boxed.portion: 1 filled cookie per guest or box
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Fill day-of where possible so biscuit keeps texture. Pack flat and do not stack soft filled cookies.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Gold dust, chocolate drizzle, edible flowers or flavour-matched crumb as optional premium finish.

dessert_platter.portion: count by ordered cookies, base recipe yield 24 cookies
dessert_platter.service_rule: Fill close to service and separate flavours clearly on platter.
dessert_platter.premium_garnish_option: Edible flowers or flavour-matched garnish as optional premium finish.

corporate_boxed.portion: 1 serve per guest, 3 finger sandwiches per serve
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Filling split must be set on the event prep sheet. Do not use vague chef selection for kitchen-facing counts.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or premium fruit garnish only where packing allows.

platter.portion: 12 serves per built-in batch, 3 finger sandwiches per serve
platter.service_rule: Cut cleanly, keep wrapped/chilled, and build flavour split from event prep sheet.
platter.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, edible flowers or premium fruit garnish as optional premium finish.

corporate_boxed.portion: 1 roasted vegetable salad bowl per guest
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Cool roasted vegetables before lidding unless served warm. Keep dressing separate for longer holding.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Pepitas, micro herbs or edible flowers as optional premium finish.

kids.service_rule: Cut fruit into safe pieces for age group. Label allergens and keep nut products out unless specifically approved.
kids.premium_garnish_option: Not required; keep child-friendly and safe.

kids.portion: 1 mild spaghetti bolognese serve per child
kids.service_rule: Keep mild. Sauce pasta lightly and serve extra sauce separately when practical.
kids.premium_garnish_option: Not required; parmesan only unless requested.

corporate_boxed.portion: 1 bacon and egg muffin per guest
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Build hot and wrap for transport. Sauce optional; confirm before adding.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Not required for wrapped breakfast item.

corporate_boxed.portion: 1 bacon and egg panini per guest
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Press until marked, cut only if requested, vent briefly before boxing.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Not required for boxed panini; premium relish is the finish.

corporate_boxed.service_rule: Hold waffles on rack, not stacked. Pack butter and maple separately.
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Berries, edible flowers or toasted coconut as optional premium finish.
Basil oil, micro basil or edible flowers as optional premium finish.
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Hold chilled below 5 C. Refresh with basil oil at send if needed.

buffet.portion: 200 g finished salad per guest with 1.1 production allowance
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro basil or edible flowers as optional premium finish.
buffet.service_rule: Keep chilled and refresh in small batches.

corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Toasted almonds, micro herbs or edible flowers as optional premium finish.
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Hold chilled. Keep nuts separate if nut-free dietaries are present.

buffet.portion: 180 g finished salad per guest with 1.1 production allowance
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or edible flowers as optional premium finish.
buffet.service_rule: Refresh in small batches and label nuts clearly.

corporate_boxed.portion: 1 pumpkin feta salad serve per guest
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs, edible flowers or extra toasted pepitas as optional premium finish.
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Cool pumpkin before boxing unless sold warm. Keep leaves from wilting by layering carefully.

buffet.portion: 200 g finished salad per guest with 1.1 production allowance
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or edible flowers as optional premium finish.
buffet.service_rule: Refresh in small batches and keep feta visible on top.

corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Edible flowers, radish curls or micro herbs as optional premium finish.
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Keep dressing separate until send. Do not pre-dress for long delivery.

buffet.portion: 120 g finished salad per guest with 1.1 production allowance
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Micro herbs or edible flowers as optional premium finish.
buffet.service_rule: Dress at service only and refresh in small batches.

corporate_boxed.portion: 1 potato bacon salad serve per guest
corporate_boxed.premium_garnish_option: Chives, micro herbs or crisp bacon crumb as optional premium finish.
corporate_boxed.service_rule: Hold chilled. Keep bacon separate overnight and fold through before service for texture.

buffet.portion: 200 g finished salad per guest with 1.1 production allowance
buffet.premium_garnish_option: Chives, micro herbs or crisp bacon crumb as optional premium finish.
buffet.service_rule: Refresh chilled in small batches. Label pork and dairy clearly.
